notes:
I found three real options in Halton Hills. Each comes off the operator's own page.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Parent and Tot, Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre (36 Armstrong Avenue, Georgetown)",
      "age_fit": "18 months - 3.11 yrs",
      "when": "Fall 2026 session, September 12 - December 18; 30-minute classes on several days, listed in their fall schedule PDF",
      "source_name": "Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre"
    },
    {
      "name": "Pre-school Drop In, Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre",
      "age_fit": "Under 4 yrs, with a parent",
      "when": "Tuesday and Thursday 9:30 am - 12:00 pm; closed Dec. 18 - Jan 5",
      "price": "$15 for one parent and up to 4 children",
      "source_name": "Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre"
    },
    {
      "name": "Drop-in Swimming Lessons, Gellert Community Centre",
      "age_fit": "4 months to 5 years, with a parent or guardian in the water",
      "when": "Tuesday or Thursday 10:00 - 10:30 am, September 22 - December 29, 2026",
      "source_name": "Town of Halton Hills"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **Parent and Tot gymnastics:** 
The class involves parent participation and is led by a coach through a warm-up, games, music and circuits on all gymnastic events. It runs 30 minutes.
 
Their site says the fall session runs September 12 - December 18, and registration opened July 20.
 I could not pin down the price. Their fall schedule PDF lists the class on several days. I did not tie a single day and time to it, so check the PDF or ring them on 905-877-4330 for the slot you want.
- **Gymnastics drop-in:** 
Their drop-in page lists $15 for one parent and up to 4 children, Tuesday and Thursday 9:30 am - 12:00 pm.
 
No pre-registration is needed.
 
Parents stay with their child while the child explores the equipment.
 Their pages disagree on the start date: one says September 15 and others say October 9. Because they conflict, I left the start date out.
- **Drop-in swim lessons:** 
The town's page describes a 30-minute lesson where an instructor shows you how to hold a young child in the water and runs basic skills and water games.
 
It is capped at 12 participants, with one parent or guardian per child in the water.
 The town's page did not post a price that I could read, so I left it out.
